title: TaxPay and Office release requirements catalogue
purpose: Trace the active release gates to the recovered TaxPay feature baseline without overstating tests, legal coverage, or end-to-end acceptance.

status_legend.PASS: Exact stated acceptance scope passed on the referenced commit/run.
status_legend.SCOPED_PASS: A named subset passed; the listed exclusions remain open.
status_legend.NOT_TESTED: No valid evidence for the stated behavior.
status_legend.BLOCKED: A prerequisite prevents safe acceptance or hosted change.
status_legend.NOT_CERTIFIED: Source-baseline status retained; implementation or live acceptance is not certified.

evidence_rules: A source component or prototype feature is not acceptance evidence.
Every PASS is limited to its exact commit, workflow, artifact, route, persona, and test scope.
Do not infer legal correctness from v11 demo text, a prototype semantic rule, or a passing frontend workflow.
Do not infer account-owned privacy from guest-scope tests.
Do not apply hosted SQL, deploy Edge Functions, or provision officer identities while backup, migration-ledger, permission, or identity gates remain open.
